content:
## GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide

As anticipation builds for the highly awaited launch of Grand Theft Auto VI, Sony and Rockstar Games have teamed up to offer something special for hardware collectors and fans alike. According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, pre-order links for the official GTA6 limited-edition PS5 controllers are now live in the US and UK.

### Stunning Aesthetic Details

For players looking to deck out their setup ahead of the game's arrival, the collaboration brings two distinct colorways: a sleek black version and a clean white version. Both controllers feature a striking blue and purple faceplate surrounding the thumbsticks and touchpad, capturing that signature vibrant vibe associated with the upcoming title.

Adding to the collector's appeal, the official GTA6 logo is prominently printed right on the touchpad. Furthermore, both handles feature subtle palm tree indentations, offering both a thematic nod to the game's setting and a unique tactile grip design for long gaming sessions.

### Release Information

Timing is everything for collectors aiming to secure this hardware. Sony and Rockstar have confirmed that both the black and white limited-edition controllers will launch on the exact same day as the game: November 19, 2026. This synchronized release allows fans to dive into the next chapter of the franchise with matching gear right from day one.

**Editor's Take**

Hardware collaborations of this scale always generate immense excitement, and these GTA6-themed DualSense controllers are no exception. The thoughtful integration of the blue and purple aesthetic, combined with the palm tree grip details, makes them must-have items for dedicated fans looking to enhance their PS5 setup on November 19, 2026.
